metadata.case_name: CHAN OI MING v. CHRISTIAN FAMILY SERVICE CENTRE AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: employed by the 1st Defendant as a domestic work helper

injuries.description: Injury to left shoulder and left upper arm (pain, bruising, weakness and numbness)
injuries.body_part: left shoulder and left upper arm
source: she felt very painful on the joint and also at the back of her left upper arm and that her left upper arm was bruised.
she still felt pain in the neck and the left shoulder and also weakness in the left arm and also numbness.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of unspecified nerve at shoulder or upper arm level

injuries.description: Long standing psychiatric disorder (including diagnosis of schizophrenia / severe personality disorder / paranoid personality features)
source: long standing and severe personality disorder

manifestations.description: Pain in the left upper arm and bruising
Weakness in the left arm / left hand (no strength; unable to pick up a bowl of rice with left hand)
Observed inability to move left upper limb during examination (as reported by Dr Wong)
Complete change of personality / personality change
La belle indifference (detached indifferent attitude to physical handicaps)
Suicidal ideas / expressed suicidal thoughts on admission

treatments_received: hospitalisation at United Christian Hospital and Castle Peak Hospital
treatments_future: orthopaedic follow-up appointment (appointment produced for 9th December 1997)

losses.description: Complete change of personality after dismissal and the incident

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Did not have the required strength to do the chores required of her
Unable to find any work up to the trial / loss of earning capacity

comparable_cases.case_name: Ip Ah-chiu v. Wong Chun-fai and another
